results.criterion: With a standard Automobile layer active, the legend shows the titled groups and items defined by that layer’s selected legend section, using the configured categories, thresholds, colours, shapes and outlines.
steps_taken: Navigated to launcher; saved initial capture after authentication recovery.
Opened GIS and Automobile form; added Automobile - HTTP Browsing with default filters.
Inspected titled groups Error, 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G NSA, 5G SA and Out of Threshold; observed configured-looking circle, triangle, diamond and pentagon markers and thresholds.
results.reason: Groups and markers render, but the live inputs provide no versioned definition or expected colours/shapes/thresholds for an exact configuration comparison. Rendering alone cannot establish that complete assertion. Initial screenshot ENOENT was recovered by creating the staging directory and restarting from launcher. Temporary auto-review mismatch was resolved by inspecting the Automobile dialog and confirming HTTP Browsing is an expressly scoped Automobile test type. Test-created layer retained temporarily for subsequent criteria; removed in final cleanup.

results.criterion: When a visible legend item is selected, matching points in the active layer are hidden and the item is visibly muted; selecting it again restores the points and normal item appearance.
steps_taken: Started independently at launcher and saved initial PNG.
Opened GIS; captured populated Automobile HTTP Browsing baseline.
Selected 5G NSA <=3; verified Show <=3 unpressed state, muted row and disappearance of corresponding green pentagon points.
Selected it again; verified Hide <=3 pressed state and restored markers; captured final before further navigation.
results.reason: Visible green outlined pentagons disappeared while yellow/red points remained; normal row appearance and points returned on restore.

results.criterion: When a legend item is double-clicked, that item remains visible and all other items in its group are hidden; items in other groups retain their visibility.
steps_taken: Started independently at launcher; opened GIS and captured baseline.
Double-clicked visible 5G NSA >3 legend row.
Inspected settled legend: <=3, >3, >6 and >12 all remained Hide and pressed; no sibling isolation occurred; other groups remained unchanged.
Captured resulting final and current URL.
results.reason: Double-click did not isolate the selected item: all four items in the same group remained visible. No restoration required because visibility remained at baseline.

results.criterion: In Edit Legend, changing labels, colours or numeric boundaries creates drafts for the active field only; the map remains unchanged until Save, while Cancel or Close discards drafts. After Save, refreshed values remain visible in the open dialog.
steps_taken: Started independently at launcher; opened GIS; captured baseline map and complete layer list.
Opened Edit Legend; changed 2G label to QA draft first; Cancel discarded it and reopening restored <=8.
Changed label to QA draft second; Close discarded it; captured restored map and reopened <=8.
Changed label to QA saved label; Save updated the underlying legend while keeping refreshed label in open dialog; captured decisive final.
Restored original <=8 label, saved and closed; captured cleanup separately.
results.reason: Label Cancel/Close/Save behavior supported by captures. Colour/boundary drafts and exclusion of drafts for other supplied fields were not conclusively exercised; only one field exists. Baseline-map initial capture may precede full point loading; baseline-layers and both post-discard captures show settled map. Full criterion remains inconclusive.

results.criterion: Numeric Value fields use number inputs. Empty, non-finite, out-of-limit or incorrectly ordered boundary values show an inline error immediately and disable Save. HTTP Browsing boundaries accept 0–10,000; Ping and Video Streaming boundaries have a minimum of zero and no additional maximum. Video Streaming categories cannot be changed.
steps_taken: Started at launcher; opened GIS and Edit Legend.
Read 2G HTTP boundary DOM: type number, min0, max10000.
Entered empty, -1, 10001, 13 (above next boundary12), and non-finite 1e309 in sequence; captured each immediate validation state and Save availability.
Captured final validation state, then cancelled drafts.
Confirmed independently again from launcher: first 2G bound13 with next12 showed no inline alert and Save remained enabled; captured final before cancelling.
results.reason: Boundary ordering contradiction: first 2G numeric bound13 exceeded next12, but no immediate inline validation error appeared and Save stayed enabled. Empty/negative/above10000/non-finite cases disabled Save. Ping/Video and accepted endpoints remain unverified; no invalid value was saved.

conciseReport:
QA attempt 2: 2 Passed, 2 Failed, 7 Unverified and 4 Blocked across 15 canonical criteria.

Direct contradictions: double-click did not isolate sibling legend items (criterion 3); HTTP boundary 13 above following boundary 12 showed no error and left Save enabled (criterion 11). No invalid draft was saved.

Multi-field consumer/measurements and existing-consumer regression baselines were unavailable in live inputs. Partial checks are explicitly Unverified. Saved label/boundary changes were restored; numeric drafts were cancelled; viewport restored. Linked-site preference restoration was obstructed by an overlapping tooltip; final cleanup removed the test-created Automobile layer, restoring the original empty map-layer list. Separate run-cleanup-empty-map.png documents cleanup and is not assertion evidence.

All referenced PNGs are unique to their criterion and staged for publisher review. No permanent report or ticket files were written.
reason: Product contradictions and unmet multi-field/regression prerequisites require evidence review. Partial criterion coverage is reported without passing unsupported assertions.
